evals.prompt: Busca empleos Python remoto para mi perfil (5 años backend, Django, AWS) y puntua fit 5D
evals.expected_output: Shortlist con 5D scores, carta y CV adaptado para el mejor match
expectations: Searches at least one real job source and returns listings with links
Scores each listing with the 5-dimension framework
Produces a tailored CV and cover letter for the top match

evals.prompt: Evalua este posting de data analyst vs mi CV y genera cover letter
evals.expected_output: Score de fit con gaps + cover letter forward-looking + CV tailoreado
expectations: Scores the posting across the five dimensions and assigns a verdict band
Lists matched and missing skills explicitly
The cover letter is forward-looking and references the actual posting

evals.prompt: Hazme skill-gap analysis para pasar de QA manual a SDET con plan de aprendizaje
evals.expected_output: Gaps priorizados con plan y prep de entrevista STAR
expectations: Produces a prioritized gap list with a learning plan per gap
Prepares STAR interview answers for the target role
Does not invent experience the profile does not have
